subject.title: fix(kill-tree): verify process group leader before using group kill to prevent gateway SIGTERM (#76259)

question: Should OpenClaw accept leader-verified group kill as the default for omitted-detached Unix cleanup once the branch is refreshed against current main?
rationale: The code fix is a strong match for the reported bug, but it intentionally changes shared Unix process cleanup defaults and can alter descendant cleanup behavior for callers that still omit `detached`.

options.title: Accept guarded cleanup after refresh
options.body: Resolve the current conflicts, preserve current-main cleanup changes, and land the leader-check/default fallback once CI is green.

options.title: Require stricter caller-owned state
options.body: Ask for more caller-specific detached state before changing the omitted-option helper default.

options.title: Pause for process owner review
options.body: Keep the PR open but block merge until a process-runtime owner explicitly chooses the permanent cleanup contract.

recommendation.title: Accept guarded cleanup after refresh
recommendation.body: Resolve the current conflicts, preserve current-main cleanup changes, and land the leader-check/default fallback once CI is green.

likelyOwner.reason: They reviewed and merged the prior compatibility-preserving detached-option fix, so they are the best history-backed owner for the default tradeoff.
